paras: Lowering the suspension or installing wheel spacers, wider wheels, or larger tyres on BMW M2 (G87) , M3 (G80/G81) , or M4 (G82/G83) models often leads to a common issue: the factory fender liner comes into contact with the tyre during turns. This interference is typically caused by the plastic air-directing vents from the front-mounted heat exchangers.

AST/MOTON has engineered an affordable and effective solution that preserves cooling efficiency while significantly increasing clearance. This Front Wheel Arch Clearance Kit is an essential upgrade for any enthusiast modifying the suspension or wheel setup on the G8X platform.
hl: Increased Clearance: Eliminates tyre rubbing against the OEM fender liner vents when steering.
Preserved Cooling: Specially designed to maintain critical airflow to the front-mounted heat exchangers.
Durable Construction: Includes two high-quality, anodised metal plates designed to withstand the elements.
Simple Installation: A quick and straightforward bolt-on solution that mounts directly to the factory liner with all necessary hardware included.
ft: AST G8X Fender Clearance Kit for BMW M2 (G87) / M3 (G80/G81) / M4 (G82/G83)
